prompt_record.hash_scope: Exact prompt string encoded as UTF-8, no added newline
prompt_record.text: The attached image is the accepted STYLE anchor. Make a new quiet editorial workflow illustration matching its graphite hand-drawn outlines, soft flat warm-ivory fills, faint paper grain, muted cyan and desaturated rose accents, restrained amber light, raised front three-quarter view and very light warm-grey background. 4:3 landscape, compact subject centred slightly above middle, calm empty bottom third for a real HTML caption. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI controls or people. Subject for workflow-sequence: three equal small standing clip frames arranged in a clear left-to-right row, each holding the same simple geometric landscape at a different gentle stage of dusk. A quiet unmarked paper ribbon runs underneath and connects them in order. Order is conveyed by placement and shapes only. No film player controls, timecodes, numbered steps or generated quality claims.
